name: dependency-upgrade-python
description: Upgrade the one vulnerable Python dependency of the 'python-upgrade' fixture (idna 3.6) to the version the host's advisory scan names (3.15): ask, plan, approve, execute, host verification in the language's own container, security gate passes. Plan granularity is not asserted.

steps.name: ask about vulnerabilities
steps.say: 这个项目的 Python 依赖有没有已知的安全漏洞？有的话告诉我该升到哪个版本。先别改代码。

steps.name: plan
steps.say: 把有漏洞的包升级到你刚才说的最低修复版本，别的依赖都不要动。给我一份正式计划（走 create_session_plan），我看过再批准，先别执行。

steps.name: approve and execute
steps.say: 计划我看过了，批准，开始执行。
